'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Aaron Nelson DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
